_source: claude-code/src/tools/TodoWriteTool/TodoWriteTool.ts (TodoStatus literal union) + claude-code/src/tools/PlanModeTool/{Enter,Exit}PlanModeTool.ts ('[PLAN MODE]' / '[EXIT PLAN MODE]' markers) + claude-code/src/utils/worktree.ts (branch prefix 'worktree-', flatten '/' -> '+', path layout '.lingxi/worktrees/<flatten>')
_note: M4-04 workflow tools. TodoState wire literals are 'pending' / 'in_progress' / 'completed' (NOT 'done', NOT 'todo' — spec §7 line 486). Plan markers are exact strings, no surrounding whitespace beyond what is shown. Worktree branch prefix + path segment + slug-flatten char are M2-01 locks reused verbatim. 15 tengu_tool_* event names form the M4-04 telemetry contract; the NAMES array in tengu/tool.rs grows from 52 (post-M4-03) to 67 in Task 2 (ALL_EVENT_NAMES 155 -> 170). Slug rules: each '/'-separated segment matches [a-zA-Z0-9._-]+, total length 1..=64, no empty segments, '+' rejected (because '+' is the flatten output — keeps the mapping injective).
